signIn.title: Sign in
signIn.subtitle: Use your account for this installation.
signIn.otpHelp: The six digits from your authenticator app, or one of your recovery codes.
signIn.serverUnreachable: Could not reach the server. Is the backend running?
signIn.firstAccount: No account yet? The first one is created from the command line:

callback.failed: The sign-in could not be completed.

sso.provider_denied: The identity provider refused the sign-in.
sso.provider_unreachable: The identity provider could not be reached. Try again in a moment.
sso.flow_expired: The sign-in took too long or was started in another tab. Try again.
sso.state_mismatch: The sign-in response did not match this browser session. Try again.
sso.token_exchange_failed: The identity provider rejected the sign-in code. Try again.
sso.invalid_id_token: The identity provider returned a token this installation cannot verify.
sso.no_email: Your identity provider account has no e-mail address; ask an administrator.
sso.email_unverified: Your identity provider has not verified your e-mail address, so it cannot be linked to an existing account here. Verify it there, or ask an administrator.
sso.not_provisioned: No account exists for you here yet; ask an administrator to add you.
sso.no_organization: No organisation is set up for single sign-on yet; ask an administrator.
sso.account_conflict: Your e-mail is linked to a different identity; ask an administrator.
sso.seat_limit: Every licensed seat on this installation is in use. Ask an administrator to add seats.
sso.login_required: Your single sign-on session has ended. Sign in again.
sso.generic: Single sign-on failed. Try again or use a local account.
